```rust
//! Shadow (Lane 11) and Boundary (Lane 13) layer analysis.
//! Three-tier prime classification. Ramanujan spectral diagnostics.

use crate::crt::{ramanujan_sum_prime, factorize, gcd};

/// The Safe Basis — architectural constant throughout QMNF.
pub const SAFE_BASIS: [u128; 6] = [2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13];

/// Ramanujan primes S_R = {5, 7, 11}
pub const S_R: [u128; 3] = [5, 7, 11];

/// SCALE parameter for the structural sieve
pub const SCALE: u128 = 10_000; // 2^4 × 5^4

/// Three-tier classification of a prime.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PrimeTier {
    /// Tier I: Stability floor (2, 3 and their powers)
    Stability,
    /// Tier III: Accessible Ramanujan (5, 7, 11)
    AccessibleRamanujan,
    /// Tier 0: Boundary / Face-13 (13)
    Boundary,
    /// Tier 1: Turbulent (17, 19, 23, ...)
    Turbulent,
    /// Not prime
    Composite,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for PrimeTier {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            PrimeTier::Stability => write!(f, "Tier-I (Stability)"),
            PrimeTier::AccessibleRamanujan => write!(f, "Tier-III (Ramanujan)"),
            PrimeTier::Boundary => write!(f, "Tier-0 (Boundary)"),
            PrimeTier::Turbulent => write!(f, "Tier-1 (Turbulent)"),
            PrimeTier::Composite => write!(f, "Composite"),
        }
    }
}

/// Classify a prime into tiers.
pub fn classify_prime(p: u128) -> PrimeTier {
    if !crate::crt::is_prime(p) && p != 4 && p != 8 && p != 9 && p != 16 && p != 27 {
        // Check if it's a prime power of 2 or 3
        let factors = factorize(p);
        if factors.len() == 1 && (factors[0].0 == 2 || factors[0].0 == 3) {
            return PrimeTier::Stability;
        }
        return PrimeTier::Composite;
    }
    match p {
        2 | 3 => PrimeTier::Stability,
        5 | 7 | 11 => PrimeTier::AccessibleRamanujan,
        13 => PrimeTier::Boundary,
        _ if crate::crt::is_prime(p) => PrimeTier::Turbulent,
        _ => PrimeTier::Composite,
    }
}

/// Shadow analysis state for a residue differential.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ShadowState {
    /// Lane 11 residue of the differential
    pub shadow_residue: u128,
    /// Whether Lane 11 is zero (shadow bond active)
    pub active: bool,
    /// Count of near-negation lanes (diff ≡ p-1 or p-2 mod p)
    pub near_negation_count: u32,
    /// Count of half-turn lanes (diff ≡ (p+1)/2 mod p)
    pub half_turn_count: u32,
    /// Shadow strength: composite metric
    pub strength: u32,
}

impl ShadowState {
    /// Compute shadow state from a full residue differential.
    /// diff_full: differences mod [2, 3, 5, 7, 11] (first 5 of SAFE_BASIS)
    pub fn from_diff(diff_full: &[u128; 5]) -> Self {
        let shadow_residue = diff_full[4]; // Lane 11
        let active = shadow_residue == 0;

        let primes = [2u128, 3, 5, 7, 11];
        let mut near_negation_count = 0u32;
        let mut half_turn_count = 0u32;

        for (i, &p) in primes.iter().enumerate() {
            let d = diff_full[i];
            if d != 0 && (p - d) <= 2 {
                near_negation_count += 1;
            }
            if d == (p + 1) / 2 {
                half_turn_count += 1;
            }
        }

        let strength = (if active { 3 } else { 0 })
            + near_negation_count
            + half_turn_count;

        Self {
            shadow_residue,
            active,
            near_negation_count,
            half_turn_count,
            strength,
        }
    }
}

/// Boundary analysis state (Lane 13).
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct BoundaryState {
    /// Lane 13 residue
    pub boundary_residue: u128,
    /// Whether Lane 13 is zero
    pub active: bool,
    /// Threshold classification
    pub threshold_type: ThresholdType,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ThresholdType {
    Stable,
    ThresholdEvent,
    RegimeShift,
    StructuralFracture,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for ThresholdType {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            ThresholdType::Stable => write!(f, "stable"),
            ThresholdType::ThresholdEvent => write!(f, "threshold_event"),
            ThresholdType::RegimeShift => write!(f, "regime_shift"),
            ThresholdType::StructuralFracture => write!(f, "structural_fracture"),
        }
    }
}

impl BoundaryState {
    /// Compute from full 6-lane differential [2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13].
    pub fn from_diff(diff_full: &[u128; 6]) -> Self {
        let boundary_residue = diff_full[5];
        let active = boundary_residue == 0;
        let safe_zeros = diff_full[..5].iter().filter(|&&d| d == 0).count();

        let threshold_type = if !active {
            ThresholdType::Stable
        } else if safe_zeros >= 3 {
            ThresholdType::StructuralFracture
        } else if safe_zeros >= 1 {
            ThresholdType::RegimeShift
        } else {
            ThresholdType::ThresholdEvent
        };

        Self { boundary_residue, active, threshold_type }
    }
}

/// Compute residue differential mod each of SAFE_BASIS.
pub fn residue_differential(a: u128, b: u128) -> [u128; 6] {
    let mut diff = [0u128; 6];
    for (i, &p) in SAFE_BASIS.iter().enumerate() {
        let ra = a % p;
        let rb = b % p;
        diff[i] = if rb >= ra { rb - ra } else { p - (ra - rb) };
    }
    diff
}

/// Spectral analysis: compute Ramanujan sum interaction scores
/// between two candidates across the S_R primes.
pub fn spectral_interaction(a: u128, b: u128) -> SpectralReport {
    let diff = if b > a { b - a } else { a - b };

    let mut scores = Vec::new();
    let mut total_power: i128 = 0;

    for &q in &S_R {
        let c = ramanujan_sum_prime(q, diff);
        let is_interaction = c == -1; // Both "off" — shadow-correlated
        scores.push(SpectralScore { prime: q, c_q: c, interaction_mode: is_interaction });
        total_power += c * c; // power = sum of squared Ramanujan sums
    }

    // Boundary contribution
    let c_13 = ramanujan_sum_prime(13, diff);
    scores.push(SpectralScore { prime: 13, c_q: c_13, interaction_mode: c_13 == -1 });

    SpectralReport { diff, scores, total_power }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct SpectralScore {
    pub prime: u128,
    pub c_q: i128,
    pub interaction_mode: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct SpectralReport {
    pub diff: u128,
    pub scores: Vec<SpectralScore>,
    pub total_power: i128,
}

/// Check if a number is admissible (coprime to SCALE).
pub fn is_admissible(n: u128) -> bool {
    gcd(n, SCALE) == 1
}

/// 819-tier decomposition: (v % 9, v % 7, v % 13)
pub fn tier_819(v: u128) -> (u128, u128, u128) {
    (v % 9, v % 7, v % 13)
}

/// Find three-tier products: N = a² × b × c where b ∈ {5,7,11}, c = 13
pub fn find_three_tier_products(max_n: u128) -> Vec<ThreeTierProduct> {
    let mut results = Vec::new();
    let stability_bases: Vec<u128> = vec![2, 3, 4, 8, 9, 16, 27];
    let accessible = [5u128, 7, 11];
    let boundary = 13u128;

    for &a in &stability_bases {
        let a_sq = a * a;
        if a_sq >= max_n { continue; }
        for &b in &accessible {
            let n = a_sq * b * boundary;
            if n < max_n {
                results.push(ThreeTierProduct {
                    n,
                    stability_root: a,
                    accessible_prime: b,
                    boundary_prime: boundary,
                    is_819: n == 819,
                });
            }
        }
    }
    results.sort_by_key(|r| r.n);
    results
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct ThreeTierProduct {
    pub n: u128,
    pub stability_root: u128,
    pub accessible_prime: u128,
    pub boundary_prime: u128,
    pub is_819: bool,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for ThreeTierProduct {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{} = {}² × {} × {} {}",
            self.n, self.stability_root, self.accessible_prime,
            self.boundary_prime, if self.is_819 { "★ (819)" } else { "" })
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_classify_prime() {
        assert_eq!(classify_prime(2), PrimeTier::Stability);
        assert_eq!(classify_prime(3), PrimeTier::Stability);
        assert_eq!(classify_prime(5), PrimeTier::AccessibleRamanujan);
        assert_eq!(classify_prime(7), PrimeTier::AccessibleRamanujan);
        assert_eq!(classify_prime(11), PrimeTier::AccessibleRamanujan);
        assert_eq!(classify_prime(13), PrimeTier::Boundary);
        assert_eq!(classify_prime(17), PrimeTier::Turbulent);
        assert_eq!(classify_prime(23), PrimeTier::Turbulent);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_shadow_active() {
        // diff divisible by 11 → shadow active
        let diff = [0u128, 0, 0, 0, 0]; // All zero
        let ss = ShadowState::from_diff(&diff);
        assert!(ss.active);
        assert_eq!(ss.shadow_residue, 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_boundary_structural_fracture() {
        // Lane 13 zero + 3 safe zeros → structural fracture
        let diff = [0u128, 0, 0, 1, 5, 0];
        let bs = BoundaryState::from_diff(&diff);
        assert!(bs.active);
        assert_eq!(bs.threshold_type, ThresholdType::StructuralFracture);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_three_tier_products() {
        let products = find_three_tier_products(5000);
        let has_819 = products.iter().any(|p| p.is_819);
        assert!(has_819, "819 = 3²×7×13 must appear");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_admissible() {
        assert!(is_admissible(3));
        assert!(is_admissible(7));
        assert!(!is_admissible(2));  // 2 | SCALE
        assert!(!is_admissible(5));  // 5 | SCALE
        assert!(!is_admissible(10)); // 10 | SCALE
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_tier_819() {
        // 819 = 3²×7×13, so 819 % 9 = 0, 819 % 7 = 0, 819 % 13 = 0
        assert_eq!(tier_819(819), (0, 0, 0));
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Prime Hunting Sieve: Coprimality-first prime detection.
//!
//! Core insight: Primes are gaps in the shadow network — residues on the CRT
//! torus that no K-Elimination winding from parked composites can reach.

use crate::crt::{k_eliminate, factorize, is_prime, ramanujan_sum_prime};
use crate::gear::SafeAnchor;
use crate::shadow::{
    classify_prime, is_admissible, residue_differential, spectral_interaction,
    ShadowState, PrimeTier, S_R, SAFE_BASIS,
};

/// Result of a prime hunt scan.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct HuntResult {
    pub candidate: u128,
    pub is_prime: bool,
    pub tier: PrimeTier,
    pub shadow_signature: ShadowSignature,
    pub k_vort_profile: KVortProfile,
    pub admissible: bool,
}

/// Shadow network signature for a candidate.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct ShadowSignature {
    /// Residues mod each of SAFE_BASIS
    pub residues: [u128; 6],
    /// Whether the candidate is shadow-active on Lane 11
    pub lane_11_zero: bool,
    /// Whether the candidate is boundary-active on Lane 13
    pub lane_13_zero: bool,
    /// Count of zero residues across safe basis
    pub zero_count: u32,
    /// Spectral power (sum of Ramanujan sums squared against neighbors)
    pub spectral_power: i128,
}

/// K-Elimination winding profile.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct KVortProfile {
    /// Winding numbers from various anchor configurations
    pub windings: Vec<(u128, u128, u128)>, // (m_safe, anchor, k)
    /// Whether any winding hits 0 mod 11
    pub shadow_winding: bool,
    /// Whether any winding carries 11^k for k >= 2
    pub deep_shadow: bool,
    /// Highest power of 11 found in any winding
    pub max_11_power: u32,
}

/// Analyze a single candidate number.
pub fn analyze_candidate(n: u128) -> HuntResult {
    let prime = is_prime(n);
    let tier = classify_prime(n);
    let admissible = is_admissible(n);

    // Shadow signature: residues mod safe basis
    let mut residues = [0u128; 6];
    for (i, &p) in SAFE_BASIS.iter().enumerate() {
        residues[i] = n % p;
    }

    let lane_11_zero = residues[4] == 0;
    let lane_13_zero = residues[5] == 0;
    let zero_count = residues.iter().filter(|&&r| r == 0).count() as u32;

    // Spectral power: how this candidate interacts with its neighbors
    let spectral_power = if n > 1 {
        let sp_minus = spectral_interaction(n, n - 1);
        let sp_plus = spectral_interaction(n, n + 1);
        sp_minus.total_power + sp_plus.total_power
    } else {
        0
    };

    let shadow_sig = ShadowSignature {
        residues,
        lane_11_zero,
        lane_13_zero,
        zero_count,
        spectral_power,
    };

    // K-vort profile: try multiple anchor configurations
    let mut windings = Vec::new();
    let mut shadow_winding = false;
    let mut deep_shadow = false;
    let mut max_11_power = 0u32;

    // Configuration 1: basis {2,3,5}, anchor 7
    if let Some(k) = k_eliminate(n % 30, 30, n % 7, 7) {
        windings.push((30, 7, k));
        check_11_power(k, &mut shadow_winding, &mut deep_shadow, &mut max_11_power);
    }

    // Configuration 2: basis {2,3,5,7}, anchor 11
    if let Some(k) = k_eliminate(n % 210, 210, n % 11, 11) {
        windings.push((210, 11, k));
        check_11_power(k, &mut shadow_winding, &mut deep_shadow, &mut max_11_power);
    }

    // Configuration 3: basis {2,3,5,7}, anchor 13
    if let Some(k) = k_eliminate(n % 210, 210, n % 13, 13) {
        windings.push((210, 13, k));
        check_11_power(k, &mut shadow_winding, &mut deep_shadow, &mut max_11_power);
    }

    // Configuration 4: basis {2,3,5,7,11}, anchor 13
    if let Some(k) = k_eliminate(n % 2310, 2310, n % 13, 13) {
        windings.push((2310, 13, k));
        check_11_power(k, &mut shadow_winding, &mut deep_shadow, &mut max_11_power);
    }

    let k_vort_profile = KVortProfile {
        windings,
        shadow_winding,
        deep_shadow,
        max_11_power,
    };

    HuntResult {
        candidate: n,
        is_prime: prime,
        tier,
        shadow_signature: shadow_sig,
        k_vort_profile,
        admissible,
    }
}

fn check_11_power(k: u128, shadow_winding: &mut bool, deep_shadow: &mut bool, max_power: &mut u32) {
    if k == 0 { return; }
    if k % 11 == 0 {
        *shadow_winding = true;
        let mut power = 0u32;
        let mut val = k;
        while val % 11 == 0 {
            power += 1;
            val /= 11;
        }
        if power >= 2 { *deep_shadow = true; }
        if power > *max_power { *max_power = power; }
    }
}

/// The Shadow Gap Sieve: identify primes by finding residues that escape
/// all shadow network coverage.
///
/// Core algorithm:
/// 1. Fix a CRT basis B = {p_1, ..., p_k}
/// 2. For each residue r in [0, product(B)), compute its shadow coverage
/// 3. Residues with zero shadow coverage are prime candidates
/// 4. Verify candidates with Miller-Rabin
pub fn shadow_gap_sieve(limit: u128) -> SieveResult {
    let mut primes_found = Vec::new();
    let mut composites_in_gaps = Vec::new();
    let mut shadow_covered: Vec<u128> = Vec::new();

    // Sieve basis: {2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13}
    // Product = 30030
    let basis_product: u128 = SAFE_BASIS.iter().product(); // 30030

    // For each residue class mod 30030, determine shadow coverage
    let mut gap_residues = Vec::new();

    for r in 0..basis_product.min(limit) {
        let mods: Vec<u128> = SAFE_BASIS.iter().map(|&p| r % p).collect();

        // A residue is "shadow covered" if it shares a factor with any basis prime
        let covered = SAFE_BASIS.iter().any(|&p| r % p == 0);

        if !covered && r > 1 {
            gap_residues.push(r);
        }
    }

    // Now walk actual numbers, checking residue classes
    let mut n = 2u128;
    while n <= limit {
        if is_prime(n) {
            let result = analyze_candidate(n);
            primes_found.push(result);
        }
        n += 1;
    }

    // Count how many gap residues correspond to actual primes
    let gap_prime_count = gap_residues.iter()
        .filter(|&&r| r > 1 && is_prime(r))
        .count();

    SieveResult {
        limit,
        basis_product,
        total_gap_residues: gap_residues.len(),
        gap_prime_count,
        primes_found,
        composites_in_gaps,
        gap_residues,
    }
}

/// Optimized shadow gap sieve: walks only admissible residue classes
/// (coprime to SCALE = 10000 = 2^4 × 5^4)
pub fn admissible_sieve(limit: u128) -> AdmissibleSieveResult {
    // Step 1: Compute the wheel. Numbers coprime to 2 and 5 follow
    // a repeating pattern mod 10: {1, 3, 7, 9}
    let wheel = [1u128, 3, 7, 9];

    let mut primes = Vec::new();
    let mut total_checked = 0u128;
    let mut shadow_hits = 0u128;
    let mut boundary_hits = 0u128;

    // Start from 3 (smallest admissible prime)
    for base in (0..limit).step_by(10) {
        for &offset in &wheel {
            let n = base + offset;
            if n < 2 || n > limit { continue; }
            total_checked += 1;

            // Quick shadow check before expensive primality test
            let r11 = n % 11;
            let r13 = n % 13;

            if r11 == 0 { shadow_hits += 1; }
            if r13 == 0 { boundary_hits += 1; }

            // Skip multiples of 3, 7, 11, 13 (they're composite unless they ARE the prime)
            if n > 13 && (n % 3 == 0 || n % 7 == 0 || n % 11 == 0 || n % 13 == 0) {
                continue;
            }

            if is_prime(n) {
                primes.push(n);
            }
        }
    }

    AdmissibleSieveResult {
        limit,
        primes,
        total_checked,
        shadow_hits,
        boundary_hits,
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct SieveResult {
    pub limit: u128,
    pub basis_product: u128,
    pub total_gap_residues: usize,
    pub gap_prime_count: usize,
    pub primes_found: Vec<HuntResult>,
    pub composites_in_gaps: Vec<u128>,
    pub gap_residues: Vec<u128>,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct AdmissibleSieveResult {
    pub limit: u128,
    pub primes: Vec<u128>,
    pub total_checked: u128,
    pub shadow_hits: u128,
    pub boundary_hits: u128,
}

/// Cousin pair (gap-4) detector with spectral analysis.
/// Finds pairs (p, p+4) where both are prime.
pub fn find_cousin_pairs(limit: u128) -> Vec<CousinPair> {
    let mut pairs = Vec::new();
    let mut p = 3u128;
    while p + 4 <= limit {
        if is_prime(p) && is_prime(p + 4) {
            // Spectral analysis on the torus Z/pZ × Z/(p+4)Z
            let interaction = spectral_interaction(p, p + 4);

            // Ramanujan correlation: c_7(4) × c_11(4)
            let c7_4 = ramanujan_sum_prime(7, 4);
            let c11_4 = ramanujan_sum_prime(11, 4);
            let shadow_correlated = c7_4 == -1 && c11_4 == -1;

            // Residue differential mod safe basis
            let diff = residue_differential(p, p + 4);
            let shadow = ShadowState::from_diff(&[diff[0], diff[1], diff[2], diff[3], diff[4]]);

            pairs.push(CousinPair {
                p,
                q: p + 4,
                spectral_power: interaction.total_power,
                shadow_correlated,
                shadow_strength: shadow.strength,
                diff_mod_safe: diff,
            });
        }
        p += 2; // Only odd numbers
    }
    pairs
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct CousinPair {
    pub p: u128,
    pub q: u128,
    pub spectral_power: i128,
    pub shadow_correlated: bool,
    pub shadow_strength: u32,
    pub diff_mod_safe: [u128; 6],
}

/// Displacement power analysis: track how "missing" primes appear
/// in displacements between periods.
pub fn displacement_power_analysis(periods: &[(String, u128)]) -> Vec<DisplacementReport> {
    let mut reports = Vec::new();
    let eclipse = 11960u128;

    for (name, &(ref _n, period)) in periods.iter().enumerate() {
        let disp = eclipse % period;
        if disp == 0 { continue; }

        let factors = factorize(disp);
        let mut missing_prime_powers = Vec::new();

        // Check which primes are "missing" from the base period
        // but appear in the displacement
        for &q in &S_R {
            if period % q != 0 {
                // q doesn't divide the period — it's "missing"
                // Check if it appears in the displacement
                if let Some(&(_, power)) = factors.iter().find(|&&(p, _)| p == q) {
                    missing_prime_powers.push((q, power));
                }
            }
        }
        // Also check boundary prime 13
        if period % 13 != 0 {
            if let Some(&(_, power)) = factors.iter().find(|&&(p, _)| p == 13) {
                missing_prime_powers.push((13, power));
            }
        }

        reports.push(DisplacementReport {
            period_name: periods[name].0.clone(),
            period,
            displacement: disp,
            factors: factors.clone(),
            missing_prime_powers,
        });
    }
    reports
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct DisplacementReport {
    pub period_name: String,
    pub period: u128,
    pub displacement: u128,
    pub factors: Vec<(u128, u32)>,
    pub missing_prime_powers: Vec<(u128, u32)>,
}

/// K-Vort accumulator: track winding number evolution over time
/// to detect patterns in how shadow primes appear.
pub fn k_vort_accumulator_scan(
    basis: &[u128],
    anchor: u128,
    steps: u128,
) -> KVortScan {
    let mut sa = SafeAnchor::new(basis, anchor);
    let mut winding_history = Vec::new();
    let mut shadow_return_times = Vec::new();
    let mut max_k = 0u128;

    for step in 1..=steps {
        sa.add(1);
        if let Some(k) = sa.k_vort_fast() {
            if k > max_k { max_k = k; }

            // Track when winding hits 0 mod 11
            if k > 0 && k % 11 == 0 {
                shadow_return_times.push(step);
            }

            // Sample periodically to avoid massive output
            if step % (steps / 100).max(1) == 0 || step <= 100 {
                winding_history.push((step, k));
            }
        }
    }

    // Analyze inter-return intervals
    let mut intervals = Vec::new();
    for i in 1..shadow_return_times.len() {
        intervals.push(shadow_return_times[i] - shadow_return_times[i - 1]);
    }

    KVortScan {
        basis: basis.to_vec(),
        anchor,
        steps,
        max_k,
        shadow_return_count: shadow_return_times.len(),
        shadow_return_times,
        return_intervals: intervals,
        winding_history,
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct KVortScan {
    pub basis: Vec<u128>,
    pub anchor: u128,
    pub steps: u128,
    pub max_k: u128,
    pub shadow_return_count: usize,
    pub shadow_return_times: Vec<u128>,
    pub return_intervals: Vec<u128>,
    pub winding_history: Vec<(u128, u128)>,
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_analyze_candidate_prime() {
        let r = analyze_candidate(17);
        assert!(r.is_prime);
        assert_eq!(r.tier, PrimeTier::Turbulent);
        assert!(r.admissible);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_analyze_candidate_composite() {
        let r = analyze_candidate(15);
        assert!(!r.is_prime);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_admissible_sieve_small() {
        let result = admissible_sieve(100);
        // Wheel {1,3,7,9} mod 10 misses 2 and 5 (factors of SCALE)
        // 23 primes found via wheel + small-prime filter
        assert!(result.primes.len() >= 23);
        assert!(result.primes.contains(&3));
        assert!(result.primes.contains(&97));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_cousin_pairs() {
        let pairs = find_cousin_pairs(100);
        // Known cousin pairs up to 100: (3,7), (7,11), (13,17), (37,41), (43,47), (67,71), (79,83)
        assert!(pairs.len() >= 7);
        assert!(pairs.iter().any(|p| p.p == 3 && p.q == 7));
        assert!(pairs.iter().any(|p| p.p == 7 && p.q == 11));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_displacement_analysis() {
        let periods = vec![
            ("Mars".to_string(), 780u128),
            ("Venus".to_string(), 584),
            ("Saturn".to_string(), 378),
        ];
        let reports = displacement_power_analysis(&periods);
        // Saturn displacement = 11960 % 378 = 242 = 2 × 11²
        let saturn = reports.iter().find(|r| r.period_name == "Saturn").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(saturn.displacement, 242);
        // 11 is missing from Saturn's period (378 = 2×3³×7) but appears as 11² in displacement
        assert!(saturn.missing_prime_powers.iter().any(|&(p, k)| p == 11 && k == 2));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_k_vort_scan() {
        // With anchor=7, k ∈ {0..6}, never ≡ 0 mod 11
        let scan = k_vort_accumulator_scan(&[2, 3, 5], 7, 1000);
        assert_eq!(scan.shadow_return_count, 0); // k < 11 always
        assert!(!scan.winding_history.is_empty());

        // With anchor=13, k can hit multiples of 11
        let scan2 = k_vort_accumulator_scan(&[2, 3, 5, 7], 13, 10000);
        assert!(scan2.shadow_return_count > 0);
    }
}
```

```rust
fn run_validation_identities() {
    println!("── Phase 1: Validation Identities ──────────────────────────────");
    let mut pass = 0u32;
    let mut fail = 0u32;

    macro_rules! validate {
        ($name:expr, $got:expr, $expected:expr) => {
            if $got == $expected {
                pass += 1;
            } else {
                fail += 1;
                println!("  FAIL {}: got {:?}, expected {:?}", $name, $got, $expected);
            }
        };
    }

    validate!("V08: gcd(260,365)", crt::gcd(260, 365), 5);
    validate!("V09: lcm(260,365)", crt::lcm(260, 365), 18980);
    validate!("V13: 11960%780", 11960u128 % 780, 260);
    validate!("V14: 11960%584", 11960u128 % 584, 280);
    validate!("V15: 11960%378", 11960u128 % 378, 242);
    validate!("V22: 260%11", 260u128 % 11, 7);
    validate!("V28: 11960%11", 11960u128 % 11, 3);
    validate!("V19: 1872000%18980", 1872000u128 % 18980, 11960);
    validate!("V20: 1872000/18980", 1872000u128 / 18980, 98);
    validate!("V40: SCALE", shadow::SCALE, 10000);
    validate!("V40b: SCALE=2^4*5^4", 2u128.pow(4) * 5u128.pow(4), 10000);

    let crt_val = crt::crt_reconstruct(&[(2, 3), (3, 5), (2, 7)]).unwrap();
    validate!("CRT(2mod3,3mod5,2mod7)=23", crt_val, 23);

    let k = crt::k_eliminate(5, 6, 2, 5).unwrap();
    validate!("K-Elim(v=5,M=6,v=2,A=5)=2", k, 2);

    // Factorization spot checks
    let f260 = crt::factorize(260);
    validate!("260=2²×5×13", f260, vec![(2u128,2u32),(5,1),(13,1)]);
    let f819 = crt::factorize(819);
    validate!("819=3²×7×13", f819, vec![(3u128,2u32),(7,1),(13,1)]);
    let f242 = crt::factorize(242);
    validate!("242=2×11²", f242, vec![(2u128,1u32),(11,2)]);

    println!("  Result: {}/{} passed, {} failed", pass, pass + fail, fail);
    println!();
}

fn run_shadow_gap_sieve() {
    println!("── Phase 3: Shadow Gap Sieve (mod 30030) ────────────────────");
    let t = Instant::now();

    // Count residues coprime to 30030
    let basis_product: u128 = shadow::SAFE_BASIS.iter().product();
    let mut gap_count = 0u32;
    let mut gap_prime_count = 0u32;
    let mut gap_composite_count = 0u32;

    for r in 2..basis_product {
        let coprime = shadow::SAFE_BASIS.iter().all(|&p| r % p != 0);
        if coprime {
            gap_count += 1;
            if crt::is_prime(r) {
                gap_prime_count += 1;
            } else {
                gap_composite_count += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    let phi = crt::euler_totient(basis_product);
    let elapsed = t.elapsed();

    println!("  Basis product (2×3×5×7×11×13): {}", basis_product);
    println!("  φ(30030) = {}", phi);
    println!("  Gap residues (coprime to all basis primes): {}", gap_count);
    println!("  Gap residues that are prime: {}", gap_prime_count);
    println!("  Gap residues that are composite: {}", gap_composite_count);
    println!("  Gap density: {:.4}%", gap_count as f64 / basis_product as f64 * 100.0);
    println!("  Prime density in gaps: {:.2}%", gap_prime_count as f64 / gap_count as f64 * 100.0);
    println!("  Time: {:?}", elapsed);
    println!();
}

fn run_admissible_sieve() {
    println!("── Phase 4: Admissible Sieve (limit=100,000) ────────────────");
    let t = Instant::now();
    let result = sieve::admissible_sieve(100_000);
    let elapsed = t.elapsed();

    println!("  Primes found: {}", result.primes.len());
    println!("  Candidates checked: {}", result.total_checked);
    println!("  Shadow hits (n≡0 mod 11): {}", result.shadow_hits);
    println!("  Boundary hits (n≡0 mod 13): {}", result.boundary_hits);
    println!("  Sieve efficiency: {:.2}% candidates → prime",
        result.primes.len() as f64 / result.total_checked as f64 * 100.0);

    // Tier distribution
    let mut tier_counts = [0u32; 4];
    for &p in &result.primes {
        match shadow::classify_prime(p) {
            shadow::PrimeTier::Stability => tier_counts[0] += 1,
            shadow::PrimeTier::AccessibleRamanujan => tier_counts[1] += 1,
            shadow::PrimeTier::Boundary => tier_counts[2] += 1,
            shadow::PrimeTier::Turbulent => tier_counts[3] += 1,
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    println!("  Tier distribution:");
    println!("    Tier-I  (Stability):  {}", tier_counts[0]);
    println!("    Tier-III (Ramanujan): {}", tier_counts[1]);
    println!("    Tier-0  (Boundary):   {}", tier_counts[2]);
    println!("    Tier-1  (Turbulent):  {}", tier_counts[3]);
    println!("  Time: {:?}", elapsed);
    println!();
}

fn run_cousin_pair_analysis() {
    println!("── Phase 5: Cousin Pair (p, p+4) Spectral Analysis ──────────");
    let t = Instant::now();
    let pairs = sieve::find_cousin_pairs(100_000);
    let elapsed = t.elapsed();

    println!("  Cousin pairs below 100,000: {}", pairs.len());
    let shadow_corr = pairs.iter().filter(|p| p.shadow_correlated).count();
    println!("  Shadow-correlated (c₇(4)=-1 ∧ c₁₁(4)=-1): {} ({:.1}%)",
        shadow_corr, shadow_corr as f64 / pairs.len() as f64 * 100.0);

    println!("  First 15 pairs:");
    for pair in pairs.iter().take(15) {
        let d = &pair.diff_mod_safe;
        println!("    ({:>5}, {:>5}) str={} spec={:>3} Δ=[{},{},{},{},{},{}]",
            pair.p, pair.q, pair.shadow_strength, pair.spectral_power,
            d[0], d[1], d[2], d[3], d[4], d[5]);
    }

    // Residue classes mod 30
    println!("  Cousin pair p mod 30 distribution:");
    let mut mod30 = std::collections::HashMap::new();
    for pair in &pairs {
        *mod30.entry(pair.p % 30).or_insert(0u32) += 1;
    }
    let mut mod30_vec: Vec<_> = mod30.into_iter().collect();
    mod30_vec.sort_by_key(|&(r, _)| r);
    for (r, count) in &mod30_vec {
        println!("    p ≡ {:>2} (mod 30): {:>4} pairs", r, count);
    }

    // Shadow strength distribution
    let mut str_hist = std::collections::HashMap::new();
    for pair in &pairs {
        *str_hist.entry(pair.shadow_strength).or_insert(0u32) += 1;
    }
    let mut str_vec: Vec<_> = str_hist.into_iter().collect();
    str_vec.sort_by_key(|&(s, _)| s);
    println!("  Shadow strength distribution:");
    for (s, count) in &str_vec {
        println!("    strength={}: {} pairs", s, count);
    }

    println!("  Time: {:?}", elapsed);
    println!();
}

fn run_displacement_analysis() {
    println!("── Phase 6: Displacement Power Analysis (Eclipse Table) ─────");
    let periods = vec![
        ("Mars".to_string(), 780u128),
        ("Venus".to_string(), 584),
        ("Saturn".to_string(), 378),
        ("Jupiter".to_string(), 399),
    ];
    let reports = sieve::displacement_power_analysis(&periods);

    for r in &reports {
        let factor_str: Vec<String> = r.factors.iter()
            .map(|(p, k)| if *k == 1 { format!("{}", p) } else { format!("{}^{}", p, k) })
            .collect();
        println!("  {} (T={}): Δ = {} = {}",
            r.period_name, r.period, r.displacement, factor_str.join("×"));
        if !r.missing_prime_powers.is_empty() {
            for &(p, k) in &r.missing_prime_powers {
                println!("    ★ Shadow channel: {} missing from T={}, appears as {}^{} in Δ",
                    p, r.period, p, k);
            }
        }
    }

    let all_shadow: std::collections::HashSet<u128> = reports.iter()
        .flat_map(|r| r.missing_prime_powers.iter().map(|&(p, _)| p))
        .collect();
    let sr_check = [5u128, 7, 11].iter().all(|p| all_shadow.contains(p));
    println!("  S_R = {{5,7,11}} completeness: {} (shadow channels cover all Ramanujan primes)", sr_check);
    println!();
}

fn run_k_vort_scan() {
    println!("── Phase 7: K-Vort Accumulator Scan ─────────────────────────");
    let configs: Vec<(Vec<u128>, u128, u128)> = vec![
        (vec![2, 3, 5], 7, 10_000),
        (vec![2, 3, 5, 7], 11, 10_000),
        (vec![2, 3, 5, 7], 13, 10_000),
        (vec![2, 3, 5, 7, 11], 13, 10_000),
    ];

    for (basis, anchor, steps) in &configs {
        let t = Instant::now();
        let scan = sieve::k_vort_accumulator_scan(basis, *anchor, *steps);
        let elapsed = t.elapsed();

        let basis_str: Vec<String> = basis.iter().map(|b| b.to_string()).collect();
        let m_safe: u128 = basis.iter().product();
        println!("  B={{{}}}, M={}, A={}, steps={}",
            basis_str.join(","), m_safe, anchor, steps);
        println!("    max_k={}, shadow_returns(k≡0 mod 11)={}",
            scan.max_k, scan.shadow_return_count);

        if !scan.return_intervals.is_empty() {
            let min_i = scan.return_intervals.iter().min().unwrap();
            let max_i = scan.return_intervals.iter().max().unwrap();
            let avg_i = scan.return_intervals.iter().sum::<u128>() as f64
                / scan.return_intervals.len() as f64;
            let mult_11 = scan.return_intervals.iter().filter(|&&i| i % 11 == 0).count();
            println!("    intervals: min={}, max={}, avg={:.1}, mult_11={}/{}",
                min_i, max_i, avg_i, mult_11, scan.return_intervals.len());

            // GCD of all intervals
            let interval_gcd = scan.return_intervals.iter().copied()
                .reduce(|a, b| crt::gcd(a, b)).unwrap_or(0);
            println!("    gcd(all intervals) = {}", interval_gcd);

            // Factor the GCD
            if interval_gcd > 1 {
                let factors = crt::factorize(interval_gcd);
                let f_str: Vec<String> = factors.iter()
                    .map(|(p, k)| if *k == 1 { format!("{}", p) } else { format!("{}^{}", p, k) })
                    .collect();
                println!("    gcd factors: {}", f_str.join("×"));
            }
        }
        println!("    time: {:?}", elapsed);
    }
    println!();
}

fn run_shadow_gap_statistics() {
    println!("── Phase 9: Shadow Network Gap Statistics ───────────────────");

    let primes: Vec<u128> = (2..10_000u128).filter(|&n| crt::is_prime(n)).collect();
    println!("  Total primes below 10,000: {}", primes.len());

    // Residue distribution of primes mod basis primes
    println!("\n  Prime residue distribution (mod basis primes):");
    for &p in &[7u128, 11, 13, 30, 210] {
        let mut buckets = vec![0u32; p as usize];
        for &q in &primes {
            if q >= p { // only count primes above the modulus
                buckets[(q % p) as usize] += 1;
            }
        }
        let nonzero: Vec<String> = buckets.iter().enumerate()
            .filter(|(_, &c)| c > 0)
            .map(|(r, &c)| format!("{}:{}", r, c))
            .collect();
        println!("    mod {:>3}: {} residue classes occupied, min={}, max={}",
            p,
            nonzero.len(),
            buckets.iter().filter(|&&c| c > 0).min().unwrap_or(&0),
            buckets.iter().max().unwrap_or(&0));
        // Uniformity check: χ² against uniform
        let expected = primes.len() as f64 / (p - 1) as f64;
        let chi2: f64 = buckets.iter().enumerate()
            .filter(|&(r, _)| r != 0)  // skip residue 0 (only the prime p itself)
            .map(|(_, &c)| {
                let diff = c as f64 - expected;
                diff * diff / expected
            })
            .sum();
        println!("           χ²={:.2} (df={}, expect ≈{:.1} per bucket)",
            chi2, p - 2, expected);
    }

    // Ramanujan sum statistics
    println!("\n  Ramanujan sum c_q(p) for primes p<10000:");
    for &q in &shadow::S_R {
        let neg = primes.iter().filter(|&&p| p != q && p % q != 0).count();
        let total = primes.len() - 1; // exclude q itself
        println!("    c_{}(p)=-1 for {}/{} primes ({:.1}% in shadow)",
            q, neg, total, neg as f64 / total as f64 * 100.0);
    }

    // Gap-4 density by region
    println!("\n  Cousin pair density by region:");
    let regions: Vec<(u128, u128)> = vec![
        (0, 1000), (1000, 10000), (10000, 50000), (50000, 100000)
    ];
    for (lo, hi) in &regions {
        let pairs = sieve::find_cousin_pairs(*hi);
        let in_range = pairs.iter().filter(|p| p.p >= *lo).count();
        let primes_in_range = (*lo..*hi).filter(|&n| crt::is_prime(n)).count();
        println!("    [{:>6}, {:>6}): {:>4} cousin pairs / {:>4} primes = {:.2}%",
            lo, hi, in_range, primes_in_range,
            if primes_in_range > 0 { in_range as f64 / primes_in_range as f64 * 100.0 } else { 0.0 });
    }
    println!();
}

    }

    println!("  Gap classification:");
    let mut gap_vec: Vec<_> = report.gap_classification.iter().collect();
    gap_vec.sort_by_key(|(_, &c)| std::cmp::Reverse(c));

            g.p1, g.p2, g.linear_gap, g.dtheta, g.dk);
    }

    println!("  Time: {:?}", elapsed);
    println!();

fn run_shadow_minima_test() {
    println!("── Phase 11: Shadow Minima Falsification Test ───────────────");
    println!("  Claim: primes ⟺ shadow_entropy = -3");
    let t = Instant::now();
    let report = helical::test_shadow_minima(100_000);
    let elapsed = t.elapsed();

    println!("  Primes with entropy=-3:     {} (should be all primes > 13)", report.primes_at_minus3);
    println!("  Primes with entropy≠-3:     {} (these are 2,3,5,7,11)", report.primes_not_minus3);
    println!("  Composites with entropy=-3: {} ← FALSE POSITIVES", report.composites_at_minus3);
    println!("  Composites with entropy≠-3: {}", report.composites_not_minus3);

    let specificity = if report.primes_at_minus3 + report.composites_at_minus3 > 0 {
        report.primes_at_minus3 as f64
            / (report.primes_at_minus3 + report.composites_at_minus3) as f64 * 100.0
    } else { 100.0 };
    println!("  Specificity (prime | entropy=-3): {:.2}%", specificity);

    if !report.false_positives.is_empty() {
        println!("  First 20 false positives (composites with entropy=-3):");
        for &fp in report.false_positives.iter().take(20) {
            let factors = crt::factorize(fp);
            let f_str: Vec<String> = factors.iter()
                .map(|(p, k)| if *k == 1 { format!("{}", p) } else { format!("{}^{}", p, k) })
                .collect();
            println!("    {} = {} (coprime to S_R but composite)",
                fp, f_str.join("×"));
        }
        println!("  Pattern: false positives are products of Turbulent primes (>13)");
    }

    println!("  VERDICT: shadow_entropy=-3 is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT for primality");
    println!("  Time: {:?}", elapsed);
    println!();
}

fn run_first_primes_per_winding() {
    println!("── Phase 13: First Prime Per Winding (CR=18980) ─────────────");
    println!("  Claim: first prime on K=1 is 19001 with θ=21=3×7");
    let results = helical::first_prime_theta_factors(15);

    println!("  {:>4} {:>8} {:>6}  θ factors       gcd(θ,CR)  coprime?", "K", "prime", "θ");
    println!("  {}", "─".repeat(65));
    for (k, n, theta, factors) in &results {
        let f_str: Vec<String> = factors.iter()
            .map(|(p, k)| if *k == 1 { format!("{}", p) } else { format!("{}^{}", p, k) })
            .collect();
        let f_display = if f_str.is_empty() {
            format!("{}", theta)
        } else {
            f_str.join("×")
        };
        let g = crt::gcd(*theta, helical::CR);
        println!("  {:>4} {:>8} {:>6}  {:<16} {:>9}  {}",
            k, n, theta, f_display,
            g, if g == 1 { "✓" } else { "✗" });
    }

    let thetas: Vec<u128> = results.iter().map(|(_, _, t, _)| *t).collect();
    println!("\n  θ sequence: {:?}", thetas);

    for &p in &[2u128, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13] {
        let divisible: Vec<u128> = thetas.iter().filter(|&&t| t > 0 && t % p == 0).copied().collect();
        println!("  θ divisible by {:>2}: {}/{} — {:?}",
            p, divisible.len(), thetas.len(), divisible);
    }
    println!();
}

fn run_monoid_census() {
    println!("── Phase 14: Monoid M_H Census ────────────────────────────────");
    println!("  M = {} = {:?}", monoid::M_COPRIME, crt::factorize(monoid::M_COPRIME));
    println!("  NOTE: 3 ∉ factors(M), so 3 and powers of 3 ARE in M_H");

    let t = Instant::now();
    let census = monoid::enumerate_monoid(2, 2000);
    let elapsed = t.elapsed();

    println!("  Range [2, 2000]:");
    println!("    Total in M_H: {}", census.total);
    println!("    Good primes (irreducible): {}", census.good_primes.len());
    println!("    Polluted composites (factor ≤13): {}", census.polluted.len());
    println!("    Pure composites (all factors >13): {}", census.pure_composites.len());
    println!("    Outside M_H: {}", census.outside);

    println!("  First 10 good primes: {:?}", &census.good_primes[..census.good_primes.len().min(10)]);
    println!("  First 10 polluted: {:?}", &census.polluted[..census.polluted.len().min(10)]);
    println!("  First 10 pure composites: {:?}", &census.pure_composites[..census.pure_composites.len().min(10)]);

    // Verify document claims
    let doc_polluted_first10 = [27u128, 51, 57, 69, 81, 87, 93, 111, 123, 129];
    let doc_good_first5 = [17u128, 19, 23, 29, 31];
    let doc_pure_first5 = [289u128, 323, 361, 391, 437];

    let mut doc_match = true;
    for (i, &expected) in doc_polluted_first10.iter().enumerate() {
        if i < census.polluted.len() && census.polluted[i] != expected {
            println!("  ✗ Polluted mismatch at {}: got {}, expected {}", i, census.polluted[i], expected);
            doc_match = false;
        }
    }
    for (i, &expected) in doc_good_first5.iter().enumerate() {
        if i < census.good_primes.len() && census.good_primes[i] != expected {
            println!("  ✗ Good prime mismatch at {}: got {}, expected {}", i, census.good_primes[i], expected);
            doc_match = false;
        }
    }
    for (i, &expected) in doc_pure_first5.iter().enumerate() {
        if i < census.pure_composites.len() && census.pure_composites[i] != expected {
            println!("  ✗ Pure composite mismatch at {}: got {}, expected {}", i, census.pure_composites[i], expected);
            doc_match = false;
        }
    }
    if doc_match {
        println!("  ✓ All document claims match");
    }

    // Closure test
    let test_elements: Vec<u128> = census.good_primes.iter().take(5)
        .chain(census.polluted.iter().take(5))
        .copied().collect();
    let closure = monoid::closure_test(&test_elements);
    println!("  Closure test ({} pairs): {}/{} passed, {} failed",
        closure.tested, closure.passed, closure.tested,
        closure.tested - closure.passed);

    // Why is 3 special?
    println!("\n  WHY 3 IS IN M_H:");
    println!("    3 ∤ CR (18980 = 2²×5×13×73): {}", 18980 % 3 != 0);
    println!("    3 ∉ S_R = {{5,7,11}}: true");
    println!("    3 ∤ M (730730 = 2×5×7×11×13×73): {}", 730730 % 3 != 0);
    println!("    shadow_entropy(3) = {}", monoid::shadow_entropy(3));
    println!("    gcd(3, CR) = {}", crt::gcd(3, helical::CR));
    println!("    classify(3) = {}", monoid::classify_monoid(3));

    println!("  Time: {:?}", elapsed);
    println!();
}

fn run_monoid_exponential() {
    println!("── Phase 15: Monoid Exponential Reach ─────────────────────────");
    let bases = [27u128, 17, 51, 289, 3];

    for &base in &bases {
        let points = monoid::exponential_reach(base, 8);
        let factors_str = {
            let f = crt::factorize(base);
            f.iter().map(|(p, k)| if *k == 1 { format!("{}", p) } else { format!("{}^{}", p, k) })
                .collect::<Vec<_>>().join("×")
        };
        println!("  Base {} ({}), class={}:", base, factors_str, monoid::classify_monoid(base));
        for pt in &points {
            println!("    {}^{} = {} → θ={}, K={}, ε={}, M_H={}, prime={}",
                pt.base, pt.exponent, pt.value,
                pt.theta, pt.winding_k, pt.entropy,
                if pt.coprime_m { "✓" } else { "✗" },
                if pt.is_prime { "✓" } else { "✗" });
        }
        // Verify modular fast path matches
        for pt in &points {
            let theta_fast = monoid::modular_exp_reach(base, pt.exponent as u128);
            assert_eq!(theta_fast, pt.theta,
                "Fast path mismatch for {}^{}: fast={}, slow={}",
                base, pt.exponent, theta_fast, pt.theta);
        }
        println!("    ✓ All θ values match O(log k) fast path");
    }
    println!();
}

fn run_algorithm1_test() {
    println!("── Phase 16: Algorithm 1 κ-Filter Falsification ──────────────");
    println!("  Question: Does the κ-filter help predict primes?");
    println!("  κ = (θ - v_anchor) · L⁻¹ mod 17, anchor v=27");

    let v_anchor = 27u128;
    let t = Instant::now();
    let result = monoid::algorithm1_bulk_test(100_000, v_anchor);
    let elapsed = t.elapsed();

    println!("  Range [2, 100000]:");
    println!("    In M_H: {}", result.total_in_monoid);
    println!("    Good primes: {}", result.total_primes);
    println!("    Composites: {}", result.total_composites);
    println!();
    println!("  κ-filter (|κ| ≤ 1) results:");
    println!("    Passes κ-filter: {}", result.kappa_passes);
    println!("    Of those, prime: {} ({:.1}%)", result.kappa_passes_prime,
        if result.kappa_passes > 0 { result.kappa_passes_prime as f64 / result.kappa_passes as f64 * 100.0 } else { 0.0 });
    println!("    Of those, composite: {} ({:.1}%)", result.kappa_passes_composite,
        if result.kappa_passes > 0 { result.kappa_passes_composite as f64 / result.kappa_passes as f64 * 100.0 } else { 0.0 });
    println!();
    println!("  Confusion matrix (κ-filter alone as prime predictor):");
    println!("    True positives:  {} (prime AND κ passes)", result.true_pos);
    println!("    False positives: {} (composite AND κ passes)", result.false_pos);
    println!("    True negatives:  {} (composite AND κ fails)", result.true_neg);
    println!("    False negatives: {} (prime AND κ fails)", result.false_neg);

    let precision = if result.true_pos + result.false_pos > 0 {
        result.true_pos as f64 / (result.true_pos + result.false_pos) as f64 * 100.0
    } else { 0.0 };
    let recall = if result.true_pos + result.false_neg > 0 {
        result.true_pos as f64 / (result.true_pos + result.false_neg) as f64 * 100.0
    } else { 0.0 };
    println!("    Precision: {:.2}%", precision);
    println!("    Recall: {:.2}%", recall);

    // Baseline: random classifier with same monoid
    let baseline_precision = result.total_primes as f64 / result.total_in_monoid as f64 * 100.0;
    println!("    Baseline (random in M_H): {:.2}%", baseline_precision);
    println!("    κ-filter lift over baseline: {:.2}x", precision / baseline_precision);

    // κ distribution (should be uniform mod 17 if no structure)
    println!("\n  κ distribution (mod 17):");
    let expected_per_bin = result.total_in_monoid as f64 / 17.0;
    for (k, &count) in result.kappa_hist.iter().enumerate() {
        let bar_len = (count as f64 / expected_per_bin * 20.0) as usize;
        let bar: String = "█".repeat(bar_len.min(40));
        println!("    κ={:>2}: {:>5} (expect {:.0}) {}", k, count, expected_per_bin, bar);
    }

    // Chi-squared uniformity test
    let chi2: f64 = result.kappa_hist.iter()
        .map(|&c| {
            let diff = c as f64 - expected_per_bin;
            diff * diff / expected_per_bin
        })
        .sum();
    println!("    χ² = {:.2} (df=16, critical 26.3 at 5%)", chi2);
    println!("    Verdict: κ is {} mod 17",
        if chi2 < 26.3 { "UNIFORM" } else { "NON-UNIFORM (structure detected!)" });

    // The honest assessment
    println!("\n  CRITICAL ANALYSIS:");
    println!("    Algorithm 1 step 6 requires checking 'N is not a proper");
    println!("    power/product inside M_H' — this IS the factoring problem.");
    println!("    The κ-filter adds {:.2}x lift but does not solve primality.",
        precision / baseline_precision);
    println!("    The monoid M_H = {{n : gcd(n, 730730) = 1}} is a standard");
    println!("    wheel sieve step, not a new structural discovery.");

    println!("  Time: {:?}", elapsed);
    println!();
}

fn run_monoid_density() {
    println!("── Phase 17: Prime Density in M_H by Winding ────────────────");

    for (k, primes, in_mon, density) in &densities {
```
